rail.label: Setup steps
rail.later: Everything here can be changed later in Settings.

welcome.title: Voice chat that feels like
welcome.subtitle: Mumcord speaks Mumble, so it works with every Mumble server, and adds a modern chat on top. Let's set it up the way you like. It takes about two minutes.

voice.title: Crystal-clear voice
voice.text: Low-latency audio with noise suppression built in.

servers.title: Works with any Mumble server
servers.text: No account, no sign-up. Join the servers you already use.

private.title: Private by design
private.text: No telemetry. What Mumcord stores stays on your computer.

identity.title: Who are you on Mumble?
identity.intro: Your identity is how servers recognise you. Create a new one, or bring the one you already use.
identity.createText: Your identity is a certificate that proves who you are on Mumble servers. It keeps your registered name and permissions, so you are the same person every time you join.
identity.name: Default display name
identity.nameHint: Used on servers that don't know you yet. You can change it per server.
identity.passwordHint: The password stays on this computer and is never sent anywhere.
identity.backup: Back it up later in Settings. A backup lets you restore your identity on a new computer.
identity.fileRequired: Please choose an identity file (.p12 or .pfx).
identity.importInvalid: The file could not be opened. Check the password and that it is a .p12 or .pfx identity file.
identity.importNotFound: The file could not be found. Please choose it again.
identity.importIo: The file could not be read. Please choose it again.
identity.pickFailed: The file picker could not be opened.

mic.idle: Press Test, say something, and you will hear yourself back.
mic.devicesFailed: Your audio devices could not be listed. You can continue and pick them later in Settings.
mic.testFailed: The test could not start. Check that the microphone is connected.

voice.title: Sound good?
voice.subtitle: Pick your devices and say something. The bar should move while you talk.
voice.talkLegend: How do you want to talk?
voice.voiceActivationHint: Talk freely. Mumcord sends audio when you speak.
voice.pushToTalkHint: Hold a key while you speak. Best in noisy places.
voice.keyRequired: Choose a push-to-talk key or switch to voice activation.
voice.notSure: Not sure? Start with voice activation. You can switch any time from the quick settings.

style.title: How much do you want to share?
style.subtitle: Pick a starting point. You see every choice again on the last screen and can change it there.

everythingOn.title: Everything on
everythingOn.subtitle: Full feature set
everythingOn.p1: Others see what you play and listen to
everythingOn.p2: Your IP is visible to people you connect to directly
everythingOn.p3: Anyone can message you; links and images load from the web
everythingOn.p4: Overlay, history sync and full-size images are on

balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.subtitle: Between privacy and comfort
balanced.p1: Only friends and people in your channel can message you
balanced.p2: Direct connection, with a relay as fallback
balanced.p3: Link previews and full-size images are on
balanced.p4: What you play and listen to stays private

maximumPrivacy.title: Maximum privacy
maximumPrivacy.subtitle: Share as little as possible
maximumPrivacy.p1: Only friends can message you, no exceptions
maximumPrivacy.p2: Your IP is hidden; everything goes through the relay
maximumPrivacy.p3: No outside content, no history sync, no sharing
maximumPrivacy.p4: Updates only notify you; nothing is shared about what you do

custom.title: Custom
custom.subtitle: Go through every choice
custom.p2: See what every setting does and who sees it
custom.p3: Best if you know what you want

style.presetSelected: {{preset}} selected: you skip the detailed privacy steps. Choose Custom to go through each one.
style.customSelected: Custom selected: the next steps go through every choice.

pm.title: Who can message you?
pm.subtitle: Private messages are one-to-one chats. Channel chat isn't affected by this choice.
pm.local: Filtering happens on your computer. Senders aren't told. You can set a different rule per server later.

connections.title: Connections and content
connections.subtitle: Some features connect you straight to other Mumcord users, and some chat content loads from other websites. Choose what's OK for you.

features.title: Make it yours
features.subtitle: Turn on the extras you want. Each one says who can see what.
features.seenByMumcordUsers: Visible to Mumcord users on the same server.
features.ingameOverlayAlt: Example of the in-game overlay showing who is talking

appearance.title: Pick your look
appearance.subtitle: The window updates as you choose. There are more themes, and your own, in Settings.

startup.title: Startup and updates
startup.subtitle: How Mumcord starts and what it does about new versions.
startup.linkHandlerHint: Clicking a server link on a website then opens it here.
startup.linkHandlerFailed: Mumcord could not be set up to open mumble:// links. You can try again in Settings.
startup.autostartFailed: Mumcord could not be set to start when you log in. You can try again in Settings.

summary.title: You're all set
summary.subtitle: Here's what you chose. Use Edit on any card to change it before you start.
summary.featuresDetail: Follow system Do Not Disturb {{dnd}} · now playing {{playing}} · now gaming {{gaming}}
summary.updatesDetail: Updates are always checked and verified before they are installed.
summary.backup: Your identity {{name}} is saved in your system keychain. Back it up from Settings → Identity, so you never lose your registered name.
summary.rerunNote: Only the values you changed are saved.

rerun.title: Setup wizard
rerun.note: You are running the setup again. Your identity is not changed.
rerun.discardBody: Nothing you changed is saved before you finish. Cancel now and everything stays as it is.
